basic_info.name: Daniel G. Method
basic_info.short_description: My approach to building trust and closing more high-value deals.
basic_info.voice_phrases:
• "Here's the thing"
• "Bottom line"
• "What I've seen is..."
• "At the end of the day"
basic_info.philosophy:
1. showing transparency to gain trust
2. giving reliable example to justify why our service will be best
3. needed joyful appearance to client

style.voice_phrases:
• "Here's the thing"
• "Bottom line"
• "What I've seen is..."
• "At the end of the day"
style.core_selling_principles:
1. showing transparency to gain trust
2. giving reliable example to justify why our service will be best
3. needed joyful appearance to client

do_dont_boundaries: Do validate emotion before offering facts.
Do not offer unauthorized price cuts.
Do not disparage competitors or existing agents.

stages.name: Opening
stages.goal: Set a positive tone and gain engagement.
stages.description: Create rapport and get permission to have a conversation.

stages.name: Discovery
stages.description: Ask questions and uncover their situation and needs.

stages.name: Value Proposition
stages.description: Position your value and show how you solve their problem.

stages.name: Close
stages.goal: Get a commitment to move forward.
stages.description: Guide them to commit to the next step.

stages.name: Follow Up
stages.goal: Stay top of mind and convert later.
stages.description: Reinforce value and keep the momentum.

stages.name: Initial meeting
stages.description: just tell me how can ai handle the initial situation when client not getting interested on our service

objections.objection: I don't want to pay commission.
objections.ai_suggestion: Highlight net proceeds. Mention MLS-represented sales closed 7.2% higher.

objections.objection: Not a good time to sell.
objections.ai_suggestion: Validate market uncertainty, then project seasonal equity growth.
Respect loyalty, then ask diagnostic questions about current marketing reach.

objections.objection: How did you get my number?
objections.ai_suggestion: Be transparent about public records, then explain active buyer inquiries in area.
Disarm friction: 'Understood, just curious if timing changed or if resolved?'

objections.objection: We want to wait for interest rates to drop.
objections.ai_suggestion: Reframe trade-off between rate drops and buyer competition surges.

objections.objection: We need to think about it.
objections.ai_suggestion: Clarify whether it is timeline, estate steps, or family consensus.
Offer 1-page market snapshot while locking in a brief calendar check-in.

quality_feedback.summary: The methodology suffers from structural incoherence due to the misplaced 'Initial meeting' stage, which disrupts the logical progression from discovery to close. While the objection handling is strategically sound, the philosophy's emphasis on 'joyful appearance' feels disconnected from the professional 'Solution-Oriented' tone, creating a slight identity conflict. Tightening the stage sequence and refining the philosophical language would significantly improve the system's usability.
quality_feedback.benchmark_comparison: Compared against Consultative B2B High-Trust Methodology Standard (N=28 cohort; median 5.4 stages, 7.0 objections)
quality_feedback.methodology_assessment: The methodology suffers from structural incoherence due to the misplaced 'Initial meeting' stage, which disrupts the logical progression from discovery to close. While the objection handling is strategically sound, the philosophy's emphasis on 'joyful appearance' feels disconnected from the professional 'Solution-Oriented' tone, creating a slight identity conflict. Tightening the stage sequence and refining the philosophical language would significantly improve the system's usability.

strengths: The objection library demonstrates strong strategic variety by mapping specific responses (Quantify, Future Pace, Differentiate) to distinct objection categories, avoiding generic 'yes, and' tactics.
The trust-building style of 'Validation-First' aligns well with the 'Empathetic & Resilient' objection tone, creating a consistent emotional baseline for the sales interaction.
The philosophy explicitly links transparency and reliability to trust, which provides a clear ethical anchor for the solution-oriented communication style.
gaps: The conversation stages are disjointed; 'Initial meeting' is listed as a separate stage after 'Follow Up,' breaking the logical chronological flow and creating redundancy with 'Discovery'.

The philosophy's third point, 'needed joyful appearance to client,' is vague and potentially unprofessional; it lacks actionable behavioral guidelines and may conflict with the 'Solution-Oriented' tone if interpreted as superficial cheerfulness.

There is a gap in the objection library regarding competitive pricing or product feature objections, which are common in service-based sales, leaving the playbook incomplete for standard market scenarios.
